name: Poison
effect: Lose 4% max HP after acting; can KO; ends after battle.

name: Burn
effect: Lose 3% max HP after acting and physical damage dealt x0.90.

name: Bleed
effect: Lose 5% max HP after a physical action; nonphysical action still consumes one duration.

name: Silence
effect: Blocks spells and summons, not Item, Attack, Defend or physical skills.

name: Sleep
effect: Skip one readiness opportunity; direct damage wakes immediately.

name: Stun
effect: Skip one readiness opportunity; reapplication cannot extend until target has acted.

name: Slow
effect: ATB fill x0.75; bosses x0.90; mutually exclusive with Haste.

name: Haste
effect: ATB fill x1.25; mutually exclusive with Slow.

name: Barrier
effect: Direct damage received x0.75; not poison or HP transfers.

name: Regen
effect: Restore 5% max HP after acting; cannot revive.

name: Mark
effect: Direct physical damage received x1.10 and eligible skill synergies.

name: Blind
effect: Physical hit chance reduced by 25 percentage points, minimum 50%.

name: Doom
effect: Visible countdown; KO on expiry; boss immunity; cleansable and never random on the first tutorial boss.

name: Weaken
effect: ATK and MAG x0.85; temporary derived stats only.

name: Focus
effect: Accuracy +10 percentage points and critical chance +5 points, within caps.
